name: Post-Harvest Co-op Outreach
description: December outreach to multi-location co-ops: year-end close, audit prep and the next board meeting.

steps.subject: Year-end at {{account.name}}: {{account.locations}}, one set of books
steps.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

With {{commodity}} harvest wrapped up across {{region}}, most co-ops we work with are turning to year-end close. Running {{account.locations}} usually means scale tickets, settlements and price-later contracts that don't line up until someone reconciles them by hand.

Ceres and GrainSight give your office one ledger and one grain position across every location, so the numbers your auditor asks for are already tied out.

Your fiscal year ends {{fiscal_year_end}}. Would 30 minutes before the holidays work to walk through what a close looks like for a co-op your size?

{{sender.name}}
ThiboLiSoft

steps.body: Connect with {{contact.first_name}} ({{contact.title}}, {{account.name}}). Note: "Following up on my email about year-end close across your {{account.locations}}. Happy to share how other {{region}} co-ops handle it."

Ask: how long did last year's close take? Who reconciles price-later bushels to the position? What's on the agenda for the {{next_board_meeting}} board meeting?

steps.subject: Getting on the {{next_board_meeting}} board agenda
steps.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Most co-op software decisions go to the board, and yours meets next on {{next_board_meeting}}. If a system change is on the table for next year, the board will want a fixed price, a timeline and a reference or two.

We can put together a proposal sized to {{account.locations}}, with implementation scheduled to finish before spring planting. I can also connect you with a co-op controller in {{region}} who made the same move.

Worth a short call this week?

{{sender.name}}
ThiboLiSoft

steps.subject: Closing the loop
steps.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

I haven't heard back, so I'll assume the timing isn't right. If year-end close or the board packet becomes a priority before {{fiscal_year_end}}, reply here and I'll send over a proposal outline for {{account.name}}.

Thanks for your time this season.

{{sender.name}}
ThiboLiSoft

name: Price-Later Compliance Webinar
description: Invite, reminder and follow-up for the price-later (deferred pricing) contract compliance webinar.

steps.subject: Webinar: price-later contracts, what examiners and auditors look for
steps.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Price-later (deferred pricing) contracts are one of the most common findings in warehouse exams and year-end audits: open bushels that don't reconcile to the position, missing signatures, service charges applied inconsistently.

We're hosting a 45-minute webinar for grain controllers and managers covering:
- What state and federal examiners check on price-later and deferred-payment contracts
- Reconciling open price-later bushels to the daily position and the balance sheet
- Service charges, pricing deadlines and the paper trail your auditor will ask for

It's timed ahead of year-end and your {{next_board_meeting}} board meeting. Reply "yes" and I'll save a seat for you and anyone else at {{account.name}}.

{{sender.name}}
ThiboLiSoft

variants.name: Iowa
variants.subject: Webinar: price-later contracts and Iowa grain dealer compliance
variants.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

In Iowa, price-later contracts sit under state grain dealer and warehouse licensing, and they're a regular focus in state examinations: signed contracts on file, open bushels that tie to the position, and the bonding and financial requirements that come with deferred-pricing obligations.

We're hosting a 45-minute webinar for grain controllers and managers covering:
- What examiners check on price-later and deferred-payment contracts
- Reconciling open price-later bushels to the daily position and the balance sheet
- Record-keeping and the paper trail your auditor and examiner will ask for

It's timed ahead of year-end and your {{next_board_meeting}} board meeting. Reply "yes" and I'll save a seat for you and anyone else at {{account.name}}.

{{sender.name}}
ThiboLiSoft
